title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of [0.0248, 0.0277, 0.0]. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on four distinct faces. On the first face, draw a circle centered at [0.0144, 0.0144] with a radius of 0.0144. On the second face, draw another circle centered at [0.0144, 0.2792] with the same radius. On the third face, draw a circle centered at [0.6831, 0.0144] with a radius of 0.0144. Finally, on the fourth face, draw a circle centered at [0.6831, 0.2792] with the same radius. After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.6975 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into a three-dimensional object by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the vector [0.0248, 0.0277, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0865 units, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Integrate the newly created part with the existing body to form a single solid body. The final dimensions of the part are 0.6975 units in length, 0.29365384615384615 units in width, and 0.08653846153846154 units in height.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the first cylindrical protrusion
r = r.moveTo(0.0144, 0.0144).circle(0.0144).extrude(0.0865)

# Create the second cylindrical protrusion
r = r.moveTo(0.0144, 0.2792).circle(0.0144).extrude(0.0865)

# Create the third cylindrical protrusion
r = r.moveTo(0.6831, 0.0144).circle(0.0144).extrude(0.0865)

# Create the fourth cylindrical protrusion
r = r.moveTo(0.6831, 0.2792).circle(0.0144).extrude(0.0865)

# Translate the entire model
r = r.translate((0.0248, 0.0277, 0.0))

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall bounding box: X=0.6975, Y=0.2936, Z=0.0865
# Four vertical cylinders arranged in a rectangular pattern (one at each corner)

dia = 0.0315          # cylinder diameter
rad = dia / 2.0
height = 0.0865       # cylinder height (Z)

# Corner center positions
x1 = rad
x2 = 0.6975 - rad
y1 = rad
y2 = 0.2936 - rad

# Create the four cylinders
part = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .pushPoints([(x1, y1), (x2, y1), (x1, y2), (x2, y2)])
    .circle(rad)
    .extrude(height)
)

r = part

    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .pushPoints([
        (-half_x, -half_y),
        ( half_x, -half_y),
        (-half_x,  half_y),
        ( half_x,  half_y),
